==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
My friends and I are dream walkers. We have a special shapeshifting house that allows us to travel from one dream to the next. Each dream is it's own universe in the multiverse.

Inside the shapeshifting house is a small fluffy gray chair and a lever. In order to switch universes, all we have to do is pull the lever. Whenever the universe changes, so too does the house.

My friends and I are all aware of the fact that we are in a dream. Despite knowing we're dreaming, none of us seem to have the ability to manipulate our dream like in a normal lucid dream. I don't have an official rulebook or anything, but maybe we can't control the dream because we are traveling through other people's dreams?
